issue_request: FHIR-14738 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 PHER issue for FHIR-core-OccupationalData. It asked whether OccupationalData.author meant the person providing the data or the person recording it, and the resolution required clearer wording, a reference-list update, and a separate entering-user or recorder concept.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied in svn 13307. The corresponding Git commit 1834d69412f3ba4890c5930897e1a58b6c98aad0 explicitly references GF#14738/#163 and changed source/occupationaldata by replacing OccupationalData.author with OccupationalData.recorder, adding OccupationalData.informant, and updating the example from Author to Recorder/Informant.
additional_context: PHWG 2018 WGM minutes for Comment 163 record the same ambiguity and say the resource needed both the person providing the data and the person who entered it. Later final issues FHIR-16930 and FHIR-14868 withdrew OccupationalData as a FHIR core resource. Commit efef182022eba3d6868acbe3fda5360783848135 removed active OccupationalData build mappings, current source/fhir.ini retains only a commented dropped-resource note, current source has no occupationaldata.html page, and combined-branch commit 9ee22091b6346c46d4c6d948113f496a86ad1a52 removed a stale Resource Guide row. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout has no OccupationalData definition.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current built core specification has no active OccupationalData resource to correct, and the retained inactive source already contains the historical recorder/informant split with no OccupationalData.author element.
